title: Grid-Tied, Hybrid, Off-Grid
premise: Grid-tied systems shut down in a brownout for safety; hybrid backup depends on battery and wiring; off-grid relies on its own batteries. Their backup capability is not the same.
scriptBasis: Claude draft from the 104-episode backlog title/angle, V1.1 brand lines; claims checked online 2026-11-24.

sources: Sources: ERC/DOE net-metering interconnection framework; Fronius & SMA

cues.text: Grid-tied, hybrid, o off-grid: alin ang para sa'yo?
Grid-tied: solar at grid ang magkatuwang, walang battery.
Kapag brownout, kusa itong namamatay para sa safety.
Hybrid: may battery, pero depende sa setup ang backup.
Off-grid: walang grid, battery ang sandalan sa gabi.
Kaya hindi pare-pareho ang backup ng tatlo.
Itanong muna: anong loads ang kailangan sa brownout?
Dahil ang gusto ni Kuya SoLight… naka-solar ka na, SoSmart ka pa!

claims.wording: A grid-tied system without battery shuts down during a grid outage for safety.
claims.caveats: Some special inverters can power limited loads in daytime outages; not typical.

onlineCheck.policy: Owner (CHRIS) waived the human technical reviewer for now on 2026-11-24; claims checked online against published data instead.
onlineCheck.note: Compliant inverters must disconnect when the grid goes down to avoid backfeeding lines where crews work (PH distributor guidance; ERC NMIS islanding requirement).

claims.wording: A hybrid system's backup depends on its battery and backup setup.
claims.caveats: Backup may cover only critical loads.

onlineCheck.policy: Owner (CHRIS) waived the human technical reviewer for now on 2026-11-24; claims checked online against published data instead.
onlineCheck.note: Manufacturer docs: backup needs compatible battery plus backup wiring/switching; not automatic.

claims.wording: An off-grid system has no grid connection and relies on its batteries when there is no sun.

onlineCheck.policy: Owner (CHRIS) waived the human technical reviewer for now on 2026-11-24; claims checked online against published data instead.
onlineCheck.note: Definition of off-grid; storage supplies loads when PV is not producing.

sources.title: Solar-plus-storage / Homeowner's Guide to Going Solar
excerpts: Batteries can store solar energy produced during the day for use at night or during outages, if the system is designed for it.

sources.title: Net-Metering Rules and Interconnection Standards (Philippine Distribution Code framework)
excerpts: Net-metered systems follow the Philippine Distribution Code and ERC Net-Metering Interconnection Standards, which include islanding protection.

sources.title: Backup power function
excerpts: Backup operation requires a compatible battery and the appropriate backup wiring/switching to separate the home circuits from the grid.

sources.title: Guerilla solar installations need to be controlled, says Philippine power distributor
excerpts: In a compliant system, the inverter must immediately disconnect when the grid goes down to prevent backfeeding electricity into power lines.

sources.title: Battery-backup function
excerpts: Battery-backup operation must be set up and wired as a backup system; not for loads that need an uninterrupted supply.

caption.main:
Grid-tied, hybrid, o off-grid? Ang grid-tied ay namamatay sa brownout para sa safety. Ang hybrid backup ay depende sa battery at setup. Ang off-grid ay battery ang sandalan. Hindi pare-pareho ang backup! 🔋

SoSmart viewers, ano'ng appliances ang gusto n'yong tumakbo sa brownout? 👇
caption.pinnedComment: Sources: ERC/DOE net-metering interconnection framework; Fronius and SMA backup documentation; CleanTechnica May 2026 (checked 24 Nov 2026). Iba-iba ang backup depende sa equipment at wiring.

caption.cta: Ano'ng loads ang kailangan mo sa brownout?
